description: Source code for a Python-based build system handler within a recipe creation tool, including class definitions, functions for parsing setup.py, dependency scanning, and handling package data.

classes.name: PythonRecipeHandler
classes.description: A class that handles Python recipe build system logic, including parsing setup.py, dependency analysis, and metadata extraction.

classes.name: SetupScriptVisitor
classes.description: AST visitor class for extracting setup() call arguments and imported modules from setup.py.

classes.name: LiteralAstTransform
classes.description: AST transformer class to evaluate and simplify setup.py AST nodes into literals.

methods.name: tinfoil_init
methods.description: Initializes the global tinfoil variable with an instance.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to process a source tree, parse setup.py, and generate build metadata and dependencies.

methods.name: get_pkginfo
methods.description: Reads and parses PKG-INFO file into a dictionary.

methods.name: parse_setup_py
methods.description: Parses setup.py to extract setup() arguments and imported modules.

methods.name: get_setup_args_info
methods.description: Runs setup.py with specific arguments to extract metadata info.

methods.name: get_setup_byline
methods.description: Extracts specific setup.py argument values by running commands.

methods.name: apply_info_replacements
methods.description: Applies regex replacements to setup metadata fields.

methods.name: scan_setup_python_deps
methods.description: Scans setup.py for Python dependencies based on source files.

methods.name: scan_python_dependencies
methods.description: Runs external commands to determine Python module dependencies.

methods.name: parse_pkgdata_for_python_packages
methods.description: Parses package data files to identify provided Python packages.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Executes a subprocess command and returns output.
